title: Manson's War
overview: Beyond the flatland's where the Spahn Ranch once stood a gathering of Charles Manson devotees find refuge in the woods. When a member of their group is brutally attacked they are forced to take revenge.

title: Scarlet Nose
overview: A dangerous game of cat and mouse ensues when a party clown is discovered beside a mutilated body.

title: REEL
overview: After a late-night slasher screening, a group of horror-loving friends find themselves trapped in a terrifying game where slasher movie rules become reality. As eerie events unfold, they realize someone is rewriting the genre—forcing them to fight for survival in a film that’s still being written. The only way out? Break the rules before it’s too late.

title: My Duchess
overview: Telling the story of the final years of the woman who married King Edward VIII and broke up the monarchy.

title: Shredded Cheese
overview: A mockumentary follows a young man whose uncontrollable addiction to shredded cheese begins to disrupt his daily life and worry the people around him.

title: Midnight Daydream
overview: A man reminisces on one blurry night and begins to regret his choices.

title: Holly
overview: Holly arrives at church to pray for protection and  is greeted by an entity that craves her innocence.

title: The Wicked Hour
overview: A documentary director gathers her friends to document a haunted house, only to witness horrific paranormal activity.

title: Letters This Christmas
overview: A young romance author leaves New York City after her novel is panned, hoping to write a redemption novel from home in Alaska. Finding inspiration in her former lover, and the mysterious Christmas cards left at her keys, newfound success has her making the difficult choice between returning to New York for a career of fictional romance, and her real romance in Alaska.

title: The Perfect Warrior
overview: On a remote island deep in the Orange Sea, an elite clan of warriors called the Totomé train and fight to keep peace among their lands. Every 100 years the top warriors compete to see who will take over as leader, or Abeoji. Katana and Sai are given this opportunity, but when their forbidden relationship is discovered their final challenge to become the leader is to fight in a Si Dou— a sword fight to the death.

title: Come In From the Cold
overview: A foreign student, stranded on campus over winter break, decides to make a video diary.

title: Rusty Horse
overview: Obsessed with understanding his Vietnamese girlfriend's final words before her suicide, a grieving young man seeks help from a therapist who speaks her language. Only to break down, as does meaning in the face of grief.

title: When Cooling-Off Ends
overview: The brutal legacy of a serial killer haunts a seemingly wholesome community.

title: Red Ink
overview: In post-WWII New York, media propaganda, institutional power, and exploitation are interrogated amid the looming threat of a mysterious global virus.

title: Being Heumann
overview: Scrappy, defiant, and done being treated like a burden, Judy Heumann turns her outrage into a revolution. In 1977, she and more than 100 disability rights protestors send a very loud message: The system is broken—not us.

title: The Policewoman
overview: Former Victoria detective Narelle Fraser investigated some of Australia’s highest profile crimes. Her easy manner allowed her to gain rapport with many perpetrators, leading to their convictions… but it all came at a price. The constant daily exposure to horrific crime had a cumulative effect on Narelle’s mental health. She hid the effects for 27 years, but after suffering panic and amnesia, she received a diagnosis of PTSD, which forced her discharge from the Police. THE POLICEWOMAN illustrates the crimes that caused her descent into hell, and the battle to claw her way out. Narelle’s positive outcome in this true crime feature will demystify the stigma of mental health and speak to millions of first responders around the world.

title: Finding Faith
overview: A short film contextualising the cultural significance of George Michael's Faith album via unheard interview voice-over, unseen images by Herb Ritts, and behind-the-scenes footage of the Faith music video.

title: Marriage Test
overview: In a mosque waiting room in 1980s South Wales, a young Welsh woman and her Iranian fiancé prepare for an Islamic conversion ceremony that will test the strength of their love and their resolve.

title: Therapy with a Zombie
overview: A zombie seeks therapy after realising he's addicted to eating brains.

title: Scream: Short Film
overview: After a brutal murder reawakens Woodsboro's dark past, Cora Clemenzo is pulled into a new Ghostface killing spree as her friends in the Woodsboro High Cinema Club become suspects and survival means uncovering the truth before history repeats itself...

title: i <3 seals
overview: "i <3 seals" is a music video by American underground rapper bleood, directed by noahsocold. Released on YouTube on April 24, 2026, it promotes bleood's song of the same name, matching its woozy, rage-tinged sound.

title: Time & Time Again
overview: After moving homes, a young couple acquire the Timecrowave, a mysterious microwave that ages anything placed inside.

title: Auber 89
overview: Aubervilliers, a Parisian working-class suburb, in the 1980s: Fatsah Bouyahmed, then in his teens, recalls the past and revives solidarity-filled life stories from the archive footage.

title: The Lost Ones
overview: When a perfect family relocates to rural America, their isolated idyll quickly becomes threatened by a disturbingly volatile neighbor.

title: Rancho Mirage
overview: To avoid being put in memory care by his son, a man with Alzheimer's runs away to visit his deceased brother in Las Vegas.

title: Proposal
overview: When a brother tries to stop his sister from proposing to her girlfriend, the siblings peel back the layers of their relationship in real time.

title: In the Ever
overview: Blending intimate voice-over with the fractured memories of a 1970s folksinger, IN THE EVER follows Sam Ellis, a mechanic, whose songs written for his dead mother become a surprise hit. Unable to cope with fame, Sam retreats to a desert ranch, where an unexpected love affair forces him to confront his pain in order to move forward.  The film is a love letter infused in music. With 70s needle drops, an original score by Sonny Luca, and original music by lead actor and co-writer/director C.M. Sutton, watching IN THE EVER feels like listening to a complete album.

title: Marguerite
overview: Inspired by a true story, Marguerite recounts the fate of Marguerite de la Rocque, a sixteenth-century noblewoman marooned on an island off Newfoundland, who survives the loss of everything she loves.

title: Riverrun
overview: Lucy is a musician who is slowly losing control over her body and voice. Her psychiatrist Dr. Cruz sends her to a clinic in Spain where she meets Tony. What begins as a treatment slowly becomes a journey towards an unexpected understanding of herself.

title: The Late in Life Guide to Modern Day Lesbianism
original_title: The Late in Life Guide to Modern Day Lesbianism
overview: Congratulations on finally coming out. Equal parts orientation, indoctrination, and camp, this satirical 90s corporate training video onboards "late-in-lifers" with everything you didn't know you needed to survive modern-day lesbianism.

title: Hide
overview: A reclusive hunter clashes with her ambitious son over whether or not to capitalize on a tragic, coveted  family heirloom.

title: Born 2 Feel
overview: Two angels wander around the Duwamish River Valley. Asking questions, feeling feelings.

title: truyền thuyết (con rồng, cháu tiên)
overview: A mother tells her unborn child her version of the vietnamese creation myth.

title: The Virgins
overview: Two straight-A high school girls break free for a secret weekend, unknowingly attracting the attention of two angry young men.

title: The Apex Predators Club
overview: On a remote island where the rich hunt monsters, the game flips when the hunters become prey. With savage beasts closing in and no escape, survival is the only rule. Welcome to The Apex Predators Club.

title: Klara and the Sun
overview: When Klara, an Artificial Friend who wants nothing more than to find the perfect home, meets Josie, each immediately senses a kindred spirit in the other. Josie has a fraught relationship with her mother and they've suffered great loss, but Klara's innocent wonder and unwavering loyalty begin to heal the family and bring light to Josie's complicated world.

title: Follow Me
overview: When Gidon Lev was just 6 years old, he arrived at the Nazi concentration camp of Theresienstadt. When he was 85 years old, he took social media by storm.

title: Liquid Courage
overview: An aspiring artist is stuck as a bartender when she is encouraged by a loud, talking bottle of alcohol to throw everything away and chase her dreams.

title: Stars on the Ceiling
overview: On the war's anniversary, a Ukrainian woman in Toronto must choose between her fiancé's family or supporting her war-displaced niece.

title: fracture summer
overview: The choreography of an injured summer. Sunlight moves through rooms, my period marks time passing, and PTSD rearranges the clock. My broken Super 8 camera needs to be shaken for the shutter release to catch, and I wonder how to stay functioning, myself. The document of being unable to walk during an especially Crip summer inside my apartment.

title: Super Scam Me
overview: After years of reporting on the scam industry, Mariana van Zeller enters one of her most immersive investigations to date. In a real-life social experiment, she builds a new online dating persona and goes undercover as the target of a romance scam to understand and expose the tactics, technologies, and psychological manipulations these criminals utilize to deceive their victims.

title: Dating Sucks
overview: A vampiress navigates the turmoils of modern dating.

title: Scars and Splinters
overview: A young woman fights for survival against a mysterious botanical infection

title: Mercy
overview: Elizabeth moves into a large home after a local teenager disappears. While settling in, she befriends a local boy named Mike but keeps her distance. When she plans to meet a mysterious man she’s been messaging online, Mike tries to stop her, uncovering secrets about Elizabeth along the way.

title: Alchemy in Venice
overview: In the eclectic world of Venice Beach, three artists searching for purpose find their lives unexpectedly intertwined.

title: Midnight Dreamers
overview: In a post-dystopian world, two brothers are chased by a relentless hunter after the oldest abandons his labor camp post to seek a refugee haven in order to save his younger brother’s future.

title: In Dreaming
overview: Ryan is destined to dance, but has to put his passion aside to fulfil his duties at his family’s nail salon.

title: Burger Time 3
overview: Finn Horsman’s video

title: The flash drive killer case
overview: This Mockumentary horror about officers find flash drive in the park And it was found that there were 3 video clips that were less than 1 minute long, as follows Video 1 Joe Possessed by a ghost and hit on the head into the wall Video 2 a curse movie film scene and Video 3 show William O Jack got shot by Fred and police found out Fred is the owner of that flash drive and the how the flash drive killer case was begin.

title: Trust Me, I'm a Doctor
overview: The life of Dr. Sandeep Kapoor was turned upside down when he's implicated in the wrongful death trial of one-time Playboy centerfold Anna Nicole Smith.

title: One Eye Open
overview: A recent college graduate house-sitting for her ailing grandfather finds herself caught in a deadly cat-and-mouse game with thieves who become haunted by something supernatural protecting her in the mysterious mansion.

title: White Belt
overview: Set in present-day Los Angeles, this Dramedy follows Rick Dale as he pursues his passion of becoming a writer. When a new student Tay comes in and upsets the balance of the predominately male Jiu Jitsu gym, Rick does everything in his power to try and scare her away. In the end, his hand is forced when he realizes she is an esteemed author he happens to love. In exchange for training, Rick bargains for Tay's tutelage and expertise in the world of prose. Tay makes Rick ultimately realize that he is irrevocably bad at writing and has been shucking his true calling and responsibility of being the Jiu Jitsu champion that he is.

title: Nature
overview: Eight longtime friends head deep into the wilderness for an annual camping trip, hoping for a weekend away from the pressures of everyday life. But when a masked stranger emerges from the woods and brutally murders one of them, their getaway becomes a fight for survival. Trapped and surrounded by a mysterious group known as The Eyes, the remaining campers are given an impossible choice: identify a supposed traitor among them...or sacrifice one of their own each night. With no way out and trust becoming a liability, the group must decide how far they are willing to go to survive.

title: Opt Out
overview: Four friends from a long-buried crime are brought back together by a coded text, only to learn that the secret they thought was safe has come unraveled.

title: Someday They'll Go Down Together
overview: Bonnie & Clyde live on the margins, bound together by status, devotion, and a shared defiance of a world that has already written their ending.

title: A Month in Minnesota
overview: When a federal ICE invasion brought chaos and death to their streets and neighborhoods, an unlikely network of grassroots organizers, local business owners, students, and caregivers stepped forward to act. From a nurse midwife visiting pregnant women who were afraid to leave their homes, to a songleader helping people raise their voices in unified protest, the film showcases a diverse coalition who stood up for their community.

title: The Lost Land
overview: The Lost Land is a short documentary about an ancient forest that sank beneath the Baltic Sea 12,000 years ago. The film follows Professor Vladas Žulkus and his team as they explore the seabed and study the remains of the trees. Their discoveries help us understand the past and reveal how climate change could reshape our coastline in the future.

title: Testing Testing Sandi Bachom
overview: An unlikely citizen journalist finds redemption on the frontlines documenting white supremacy and domestic terrorism in the United States, beginning with Charlottesville.

title: Balik na, Lola
overview: Told from the perspective of her grandson, Rita returns back to the Philippines after years apart. Family, nostalgia, pain sitting exactly where they were before.

title: Whitewater Inc.
overview: A total loser has a bad day at work.

title: Gardener's Planet!
overview: A TV Gardener who discovers that the people whose garden he is working on aren't actually people at all but evil aliens from another planet and he has to defeat them before it's too late.

title: Where's Your Sunset Spot?
overview: David, a gay high school senior, embarks on an end-of-summer road trip with his best friend Annie. Along the way, he begins to question what he thought he understood about his identity.

title: Boy Mom
overview: A nervous woman meets her adult boyfriend's overbearing mother.

title: Junkies of Dreaming
overview: Orchestra rehearsals with Teodor Currentzis. The House of the Radio of the GDR in Berlin. A young couple in love. The artistic process viewed from the outside – and from the inside. Mahler’s boundary-breaking Third Symphony. What triggered the composition 130 years ago, and what does it trigger in us today?

title: Redemption River
overview: Stranded after a rafting accident, a couple on the brink of collapse must come together to escape the unforgiving wilderness.

title: Noir et Blanc
overview: After a month of hiding, Detective M has been called by a police chief to investigate the murder, not knowing if he’s in on it or not.

title: Carlo Acutis: The Millennial Saint
overview: The documentary unfolds as a journey through the life of Carlo Acutis – from pilgrimages to Assisi to digital communities around the world, up to his canonisation – illustrating the constant dialogue between earthly life and transcendent reality. It shows how the message of "the first saint of the digital age" can transcend religious boundaries and speak to different generations and distant cultures, reaching from his parish in Milan to Cascia, La Verna, Lanciano, Fátima, Rome and many countries around the world, where his words have resonated and been embraced.

title: Maleepnedos
overview: An epic journey of uncanny proportion in which two friends must adapt and survive the peculiarities of this strange new world.

title: Elements of Endearment
overview: Following Ophélie through New York, the film unfolds in five chapters—Metal, Earth, Fire, Wood, and Water—each giving rise to a different tale of dating, desire, and intimate misadventure in the city.

title: KDE: The Documentary
overview: This is the story of KDE — from Matthias Ettrich's 1996 Usenet call for a better Linux desktop environment, through the Qt licensing fight that split the free desktop world, the KDE 4 release that nearly broke the community, and the powerful reemergence.

title: Vocabulary
overview: Andy, a young chunky Chinese newcomer, arrives in London’s gay scene full of wonderful dreams. What he finds instead: somewhat racist Grindr bios, slang he can’t decipher (“bog roll”), and rules no dictionary can teach. Over three sex/dates, he stumbles through the unspoken vocabulary of sex, love, and belonging.

title: Last Night at the Alamo
overview: A canceled Hollywood actor travels to Pittsburgh in an attempt to revive his career and ends up involved with a group of wannabe left-wing terrorists.

title: I'll Be Doggone
overview: Describing the last visit to a loved ones home, stripped of its character and put on the market, with the backdrop of the destruction of the animatronic band, The Rock-afire Explosion.

title: (Failing to Make) A Documentary About My Sudanese Family
original_title: (Failing to Make) A Documentary About My Sudanese Family
overview: A filmmaker sets out to document a trip with his family in the shadow of a civil war, but finds the process undoing the film itself.

title: Let's Have Kids!
overview: Two best friends, Emma and Phoebe, decide to get pregnant simultaneously to navigate motherhood together, but their friendship is tested when only one of them conceives.

title: Spiritual Not Religious
overview: Upon meeting for the first time, Catherine and Geoff debate their spiritual beliefs. The conversation ends poorly, yet causes them to reevaluate their views.

title: Red Days 2: Cecilia
overview: Following the path of Cecilia, from Red Days, a young woman becomes a vampire during a zombie outbreak. In order to survive and find a new home, she joins a secret organization that turns her into a corporate slayer.

title: The Bloodline of Bathory
overview: A girls’ getaway at Bathory’s ruins turns deadly as a blood‑rejuvenating killer hunts them through a maze-like house.

title: Catfood
overview: After hearing mysterious reports of a creature kidnapping people in the night, Estelle finds herself too scared to feed her cats. Her granddaughter, Aurora, does it for her.

title: Brotherhood: A Cinematic Musical
overview: "Brotherhood" tells the story of two next-door neighbors: Jon, a white US citizen, and Fabián, a Mexican immigrant who learn what it means to be American and to love your neighbor.

title: Your Mother Your Mother Your Mother
original_title: Your Mother Your Mother Your Mother
overview: Latif, a devoutly religious hitman, struggles to balance work, faith and fatherhood. When his wife dies, he embarks on a desperate journey across Houston to protect his children, confronting the forces closing in around him – and the beliefs threatening to unravel within.

title: When Will You Be Back?
overview: A quiet journey through hand-drawn memories of a familiar, bygone Hanoi, where a grandson gradually comes to understand his grandmother’s life of waiting, uncovering the weight of a question he can no longer answer.

title: Knowing Gaze
overview: Knowing Gaze is a loving roast of gay culture. This animated short moves fluidly through a series of interconnected vignettes—from online personas to offline hookups, from the thrift store to the dance floor to the bathhouse.  Rendered in expressive brush strokes, the story unfolds as candid conversations carried by acidic dialogue and vulnerable interior monologues. At its core, the film probes the tenderness and tension of modern gay identity. Beneath a million witty one-liners, the soul cries out.

title: Creatures
overview: In Amsterdam, a queer Polish tattoo artist creates creatures that become part of other people's bodies. Through fandoms, online communities, and kindred spirits, we explore the world surrounding the artist, Pazur Mazur.

title: A Rose for Iris
overview: On the shores of England, a teenage girl witnesses her father's cruelty toward a migrant who has just arrived by small boat, forcing her to confront the complexities of both her father and the world around her.

title: The Florist
overview: A quiet horticulturalist harboring a secret life as a lethal assassin finds his true identity jeopardized when he forms an unlikely friendship with a witnesses to police corruption.

title: I Don’t Love You Anymore
overview: In a Niagara Falls motel, an unremarkable couple attempts a romantic getaway. But as the days go by, the trip threatens to turn into a cold shower. I Don’t Love You Anymore is a humorous exploration of the red flags we choose to ignore to keep a relationship alive.

title: This Is Our City
overview: The ambitious son of a ruthless mob boss hires a film crew, who end up being undercover FBI agents, to document his life as a dysfunctional and delusional gangster.

title: Eons
overview: A study of time's dark-flowering unknown center.

title: Fight of Fury 2 Retaliation
overview: Brandon exerts great effort and patience to rescue his daughter, abducted by a sex trafficker named Brutal. He comes so close to meeting his nemesis, but the villain escapes to avoid capture by the authorities, who he fears more than Brandon. The search must continue, or all is lost!

title: Hair Fetish Killer
overview: Documents the murder, in which Heather Barnett was found with two clumps of precisely trimmed hair in her hands, and which led detectives to Italy. It took eight years before the discovery of a second victim, Elisa Claps, finally led police to the killer.

title: Zoo Break Out
overview: A failed experiment causes four aggressive animals to escape a zoo and converge on a remote cabin, where a grieving woman and her friends must fight to survive as tensions and morality unravel.

title: Headscarf
overview: Chemotherapy leaves Candela feeling undesirable and unseen. To brave love again, she must confront her shame and reclaim her femininity.

title: REO: The Dangerous Peak
overview: A documentary following a young mountaineer, Yashwanth Naik, on an expedition to Mount Reo Purgyil in Himachal Pradesh.

title: Angor
overview: An enigmatic renegade young man, a melancholic stalked young woman, a mysterious murdered young girl and an eminent ruthless old cardinal: They live in a faithful relationship but their reciprocal dependence will soon become a pain to be freed from. Fighting desperately. Who will survive?

title: CIRCA 1919: A Hollywood Murder
overview: On the production of the first western epic, a story-hungry journalist gets her break when a "prop gun" kills an actor.

title: Strange Spirits
overview: In a haunted roadside bar run by the mysterious Ghoulian Madman, a series of twisted horror stories unfold, from cursed video games and alien body snatchers to killer clowns and supernatural nightmares, proving every spirit has a story.

title: Jackrabbit
overview: When a coal miner in 1930s Utah hides the loss of his job from his family, the quiet deception sets off a slow-burning collapse.

title: Dropping Off
overview: An aspiring musician gigging as a rideshare driver struggles to navigate the bizarre request of a mourning passenger.

title: Sport Star
overview: An aging black high school football star, living a quotidian life and married to his high school sweetheart in a small town, reminisces over a long-lost lover - a man he once shared the football field with.

title: TEENAGERS
overview: Six old friends gather at Megan’s house for a quiet reunion while her parents are away. What begins as a casual night of music, drinks, and nostalgia quickly becomes tense as old memories resurface and the group dynamic begins to fracture. As the night goes on, an unsettling feeling takes hold, turning the familiar setting into something increasingly dangerous.

title: CHASING RAHUL
overview: In modern-day Bangalore, Sama sets on to chase the old-school romance she grew up believing in, all while discovering the little beauties of Bangalore city.

title: Sweetest Day
overview: ‘Survivor girl’ Mindy prepares for the battle of her life against the undead confederate soldier that nearly killed her once before.

title: Zippy's House
overview: A troubled teen is forced to attend his strange classmate's birthday.

title: Voices
overview: When a rising soul duo overdose just hours before their big break, a desperate bellhop and his closest friends seize the chance of a lifetime, only to discover that the price of fame is blood.

title: The Last Photograph
overview: An ex-DEA operative must return to the mountains of South America in an effort to find his missing niece and nephew, following the brutal murders of their diplomat parents. Enlisting the help of a washed-up junkie war photographer, the only person to have seen the face of the killers, he sets out, determined to find the children and the truth, but soon learns he must also face the ghosts of his past.

title: Dying for Love
overview: In 1991 Miami, a young woman secretly dying of HIV finally finds the man of her dreams, and risks the only thing scarier than her diagnosis—telling the fatal truth to the man she loves.

title: Eleven Days
overview: In the sweltering heat of a Texas summer in 1974, Jim Estelle, head of the Texas Department of Corrections, plays a deadly game against the ruthless Federico Carrasco, a convicted heroin dealer who has taken over the Huntsville Penitentiary and holding dozens hostage after his pre-planned escape has gone awry. Lines between captor and captive, justice and survival, begin to blur as the siege spirals for eleven endless, terrifying days.

title: Zoners
overview: A desperate young woman is forced to drive a mercenary and a stolen alien device through a land infested with monsters.

title: Diary of a Mad Old Man
original_title: Diary of a Mad Old Man
overview: A seventy year old widow recovers from a stroke in the care of his dysfunctional family. While his body is failing him, his libido still rages on – unwittingly sparked by the attentions of his daughter-in-law, a dancer with a shady past.

title: Trash Mountain
overview: A twenty something gay man travels from Chicago to his home in rural Missouri following the death of his father — an obsessive hoarder who has left a house full of items, some valuable and some not so, to pick through.

title: The Face of Horror
overview: In medieval England, the beautiful Eleanor pines away for her errant husband, the handsome but adulterous knight Edward. When Edward’s treachery culminates in a tragedy that robs Eleanor first of her beauty and then of her life, she returns as a ghost to eke bloody revenge on Edward and his new bride.

title: Salvation
overview: A tenacious aspiring guru must go to extreme measures to pay off the debts he’s accrued from trying, and failing, to set up an online life-coaching business in a post-industrial Scottish town.  Exploring the world of male influencer culture and how it might be affecting the young men who come into its orbit, SALVATION blends mounting tension, dark comedy and a forensic focus on its protagonist to explore the very modern story of a delusional life coach spiralling out of control.

title: In Alaska
overview: After accidentally shooting at the TransAlaska Pipeline, Woody, a 17-year old Inuit, becomes the target of a terrorist manhunt. The chase through wilderness is led by veteran FBI agent Susan Tarheel, torn between doing her job and her empathy for the young man…

title: Black-Eyed Terror
overview: Encounters with black-eyed children have been reported worldwide.  The film centers on deeply personal interviews with a chemical plant worker, a marathon runner stalked on a midnight trail, a camper deep in the wilderness, and a music student home alone.

title: Mr. Setback
overview: A young couple, Layla and Pedro, prepare to meet Layla's parents for dinner. Pedro's anxiety about making a good impression leads him to procrastinate at every step.

title: Who is Columbus?
overview: Columbus, Ohio born filmmaker Renton Hinderer explores his hometown through the eyes of its residents, weaving together dozens of stories to reveal who this city is and what it's becoming.

title: Sunshine Girls
overview: SUNSHINE GIRLS follows the story of Elaine, a timid woman nearing her 30th birthday who must make the difficult choice between motherhood and medically induced photosynthesis.  After prolonged environmental destruction, Elaine’s world is experiencing a dangerous shortage of oxygen.  Science has created a solution to this problem: a “minimally invasive” medical procedure that allows women’s reproductive systems to host photosynthesis and cellular respiration, ultimately enabling them to give birth to air.  For the first time in her life, amongst the ragtag troupe of oxygen-producing misfits called the Sunshine Girls, Elaine finally begins to grow into the woman she has always wanted to be...but not everything is always as bright and sunny as it seems.

title: Censor Addiction
overview: In 2030, a group of former employees band together to take down a corrupt medical giant determined to increase the levels of crime throughout the country.

title: Be Brave
overview: A documentary film that chronicles the extraordinary personal and entrepreneurial journey of Renzo Rosso, one of the most visionary figures in international fashion and communication. It tells this story by engaging with and utilizing artificial intelligence in a provocative and original way, placing the debate over the boundaries between human creativity and technology—and between the real and the artificial—at the heart of the film.

title: Wolf Ticket
overview: A down on his luck man purchases the secret to success: a ticket that turns the buyer into a werewolf.

title: Saving Black Bear
overview: When the departure of a longtime manager threatens to shutter an already struggling movie theater in small-town Maine, a band of misfit employees fights to save the place that brought them together.

title: Place to Be
overview: No-nonsense Brooke and discombobulated divorcee Nelson travel from Chicago to New York to return a lost racing pigeon home.

title: Union Town
overview: Set against the backdrop of New York City, the film follows delivery industry workers as they take on some of the world s most powerful corporate giants, touching on the challenges, joys and human elements that make this movement possible.

title: Young Women Fighting
overview: A girl stumbles upon a group of young women in a field who fight each other while their boyfriends and brothers watch.

title: Compound
overview: Constructed from hundreds of hours of leaked security footage, Compound documents the Williams family in the months leading up to the violent incident of June 10, 2025.

title: Stavros Halkias: Uncle Stav
overview: In this unruly set, Stavros Halkias imagines becoming a "dirtbag" uncle, roasts the health care system and warns of the risks of living your best life.

title: Company
overview: A mysterious traveler tells a story that spans generations, drawing together the lives of three wounded souls struggling to choose between vengeance and forgiveness.

title: Under The Rug
overview: A man hides a dead body in his apartment and he suspects everyone who comes to the door knows what he did.

title: Last Night in Town: The Birmingham Squadron's Goodbye
original_title: Last Night in Town: The Birmingham Squadron's Goodbye
overview: An in-depth look at the final game the NBA G-League team the Birmingham Squadron play in the Magic City. The fans and team all know that this will be the last moments there, and want to do their best to win and send things off well.

title: Why Did I Get Married Again?
original_title: Why Did I Get Married Again?
overview: The couples reunite for the destination wedding of Marcus and Angela's daughter, bringing drama old and new as they ask, "Why did we get married again?"

title: If You Were…
overview: In 1979 two high school girls find each other. Over the next few weeks, their feelings unravel.

title: Brown Sheep
overview: 16-year-old Jamila navigates adolescence and natural hair confidence whilst reminiscing her mother; and attending a predominantly white school.

title: The Spirit Lock
overview: Desperate to save their possessed son, a fractured couple turns to a cursed Pagan device—unleashing a greater evil that threatens their sanity, their marriage, and their souls.

title: They're Here
overview: Edén Villa (pseudonym) and anonymous Minneapolis residents evade and resist the paramilitary occupation of their city, in a winter landscape where masked agents abduct children, residents travel in trunks, shackled prisoners are loaded onto airplanes within eyesight of vacationers, and bicyclists track the movements of an invading force.

title: Boatbuilders
overview: Over the course of 16 months, at the head of a remote harbor in Maine, the workers of the Brooklin Boat Yard meticulously build a 56-foot wooden sailboat. As the seasons change and the vessel takes shape, director Luke Lorentzen immerses the viewer in a close-knit community rooted in time-honored craft, shared joys, and mutual respect.

title: Flesh Impact
overview: A mysterious old woman auditions for a play at a small blackbox theater in New York City. As she describes her qualifications and her acting experience, secrets about her identity and the misconceptions about her life bubble to the surface.

title: Vaulder
overview: Something stalks a group at night in the suburbs.

title: 26F Seeking Friend
overview: After posting on Reddit looking for a best friend, a lonely, socially awkward woman interviews a series of potential new friends.

title: Hong Kong, Let's Get Married
overview: This documentary follows Hong Kong’s same-sex marriage movement through court challenges, activism, and personal stories as couples and advocates pursue recognition and equality.

title: The Cactus
overview: As Trysdale prepared for the year-end international exchange formal with Odessey and Malvous in a quiet afternoon, his thoughts drifted to an exchange student named Hecate when he once again locked eyes with the cactus she gave to him, whose fleeting connection with him had dissolved into quiet regret, or maybe there's still a glimpse of chance?

title: Late Night At The Movies
overview: After an Employee goes missing, Kayleigh is called into work on her only day off. She plans on spending the night after hours only to find that something sinister is lurking throughout the Theater - Stalking her.

title: Mel
overview: A man recounts a dream to his doctor where he pursues a woman who feels hauntingly familiar.

title: Once Upon a Time in Suffolk
original_title: Once Upon a Time in Suffolk
overview: An anthology film on the theme of fairy tales - some lighthearted, some more serious in tone, but all with a sprinkle of magic - and all set in the East of England county of Suffolk!

title: Onslaught
overview: When a rogue squad of genetically engineered super soldiers break loose in the desert, a badass Army sniper must unleash hell to protect her young daughter.

title: The Absence of No
overview: A sexual assault allegation at a university forces those involved and the audience to confront how quickly assumptions and appearances can distort our understanding of the truth.

title: The Sorrows of Young Charlotte
overview: After a devastating break-up, Charlie sleeps with her friend Werther on a whim. But when he confesses his true feelings for her, an unnerving and darkly explosive argument erupts.

title: BLOODLINE: HUNT OR BE HUNTED
overview: When revenge leaves a trail of bodies behind him, fugitive Tommy Crane is hunted by detectives, bounty hunters, and the very criminal empire he tried to destroy—making him go from the hunter to the prey.

title: On the Fence
overview: Stretching more than 5,600 kilometres across the country, the Dingo Fence stands as a symbol of one of Australia’s longest-running and most complex debates. On one side, livelihoods depend on protecting livestock. On the other, a native apex predator plays a vital role in the health of our ecosystems. On The Fence is a feature documentary that brings together graziers, scientists, First Nations voices and conservationists to explore the people, landscapes and ideas at the heart of this conversation. Rather than asking who is right or wrong, On The Fence asks a different question: are we willing to coexist with apex predators and learn from the mistakes of our past?

title: The Happy Place
overview: Elsie, a mother with a 3-year-old son, watches a late-night talk show “The Happy Place” to escape the horrors of her home. As her husband escalates his behaviour, Elsie must decide whether to leave, or to stay.

title: The Rattlin' Bog
overview: When three friends embark on a weekend getaway, their bond is put to the test as pride, fragile egos, and jealousy threaten to tear them apart.

title: AEW All In 2026: London
overview: All In 2026, also promoted as All In London, was a professional wrestling pay-per-view produced by All Elite Wrestling (AEW) that took place on August 30, 2026, at Wembley Stadium in London, England. The event featured AEW Men's and Women's World Championship matches earned by the winners of the 2026 Owen Hart Foundation Tournament.

title: Violent Delight
overview: A lonely artist draws her perfect companion-but the more he sees her, the more she loses herself.

title: Submitting Tigers
overview: After surviving horrific childhood trauma and rising as a professional MMA fighter, Julija Pajic finds unexpected healing, connection, and purpose among the street fighters and orphanages of Tanzania.

title: Picklish
overview: Upon the rapid rise of Pickleball in their community, three Alabama teens decide to fight back.

title: LEATHERBACK
overview: In 1994, a college film crew began documenting two promising physics students, Yulon Ackster and Anthony Schmitt, as they claimed to have cracked the code of controlling time itself. The project was expunged following a terrorist attack in Melbourne, Florida. This is the unsealed footage of what they found.

title: Look for the Lights
overview: After a funeral, Mile's finds himself having a conversation with a blissfully ignorant girl and a man who has a healthy outlook on life, the two of them try and help him fix his pessimistic ways.

title: I Think My Dad's a Cyborg and I Think He Killed My Mum
original_title: I Think My Dad's a Cyborg and I Think He Killed My Mum
overview: A lonely year after his mother’s death, awkward hermit Peter is still no closer to his father, and he thinks he knows the reason why; a reason which he must confront at the family gathering before the secret spirals out of control...his dad MUST be a murderous cyborg.

title: Reflections
overview: While rebuilding a vintage car with his young daughter, Jack begins experiencing unsettling distortions within the familiar walls of his garage. As reality quietly unravels around him, an emotional portrait of family and connection emerges.

title: One Of You Will Betray Me
original_title: One Of You Will Betray Me
overview: After her secret is shared outside of her friend group, Meghan has to figure out which one of her friend's betrayed her trust.

title: My Playground
overview: Trapped in Dubai where riding is “not allowed,” a young BMX rider hits the road on a worldwide adventure to find  epic spots, a real community — and himself.

title: Legend of the White Dragon
overview: Forced to hide in the shadows, fugitive hero Erik Reed must clear his name to reunite with his family. Standing in his way is a mysterious villain obsessed with destroying the White Dragon for good.

title: Another
overview: Joey, an author struggling to cope after her brilliant scientist husband, Ben, tragically dies. When Joey wakes one morning to find Ben making pancakes in their kitchen—as if nothing ever happened—her reality begins to fracture.

title: Electric Meat
overview: A photographer spirals into madness when a murdered model he's adopted as his new muse decides she doesn't want to stay dead.

title: Spider Island
overview: A group of social media influencers go to the launch of a new hotel on a tropical island, where they find deadly spiders.

title: Build Me a Time Machine
overview: Young Woman longs for the innocent feeling of childhood and struggles with the thought of trying to live.

title: Desert Fiends 2
overview: A group of elite bounty hunters are on the trail to track down and kill The Desert Fiends. Meanwhile, a TikTok style influencer has come into town to have a meet up while the Desert Fiends are heading that way to eliminate that meet up.

title: Tomorrow, You Pretty Ghost
overview: Two high school theater kids, prone to playing elaborate tricks on their pals, pull off one last prank before graduation with grim consequences.

title: In Bloom
overview: A witty intern resists her totalitarian society by igniting a government coup to protect her family.

title: The Headliner
overview: The Headliner is a multi-generational musical drama that explores the evolution, exploitation, and enduring spirit of hip-hop culture. The film follows a reclusive, legendary producer from the genre's "golden era" who is forced out of retirement to collaborate with a fiercely talented but unguided modern street rapper. As they clash over the soul of their music, they must unite to fight corporate greed and protect the artistic integrity of the culture.

title: Amityverse: End Game
overview: Third and final horror anthology in the Amityverse series, featuring 10 more Amityville-themed segments.

title: Novak Djokovic: The Wolf in Winter
original_title: Novak Djokovic: The Wolf in Winter
overview: He's conquered every title in tennis, including an Olympic gold. So why is Novak Djokovic still playing? The Wolf in Winter embeds with the greatest tennis player of all time as he returned to the Australian Open in 2025, capturing the obsession, the preparation, and the fire that won't go out even when there's nothing left to prove.

title: Motherhood
overview: From childhood onward, rules are imposed on us, behaviours are dictated to us, and we are told “how to live,” but we are never prepared for the difficulty of “being.” This film explores this question through the lens of motherhood.

title: The Pigeon
overview: A bereaved young woman believes her sister has been reincarnated, as a pigeon.

title: The Angel in the House
overview: Angela is living a life devoted to everyone but herself. Disconnected from her husband, Malcolm, and struggling to articulate her dissatisfaction, she leaves home the night before her family is set to attend a wedding.

title: My Little Blue Heart
overview: In a near future in rural Britain, Mustafa and his deaf sister Amna are torn apart by immigration vigilantes and their far-right policies. Amna escapes to search for her brother, only to witness a tragic event.

title: Best Served Cold: How a Revenge Film was Buried for Decades
original_title: Best Served Cold: How a Revenge Film was Buried for Decades
overview: A feature length cinema documentary on how THE FARMER (1977) became the most-requested cult film of the new millennium, and it's a crazy tale that involves an actor incarcerated for manslaughter, serious on-set injuries, banana-man costumes- as well as surprising links to Clint Eastwood and Martin Scorsese.  The film also broadens its scope to explore the overlooked, eclectic and often ultra-violent sub-genre THE FARMER belongs to - The Returning Veteran film. A film type that hit its stride in the 1970's with hard hitting character studies such as WELCOME HOME, SOLDIERS BOYS (1971), THE NO MERCY MAN (1973) and ROLLING THUNDER (1977).

title: Mysticisme du Sud
overview: Three friends search for a magic lake that mysteriously appeared in South Tunisia. While some people think it could be a curse, others believe that this appearance exists because of local practices and occult rituals. People search for it, seeking the prophetic qualities it is said to possess. Between tales, strange visions and possession, we get through a region that is still searching for something more.

title: Rocket Friendz
overview: In a world of mediocrity, Theo is a Rocket Friendz Battle Trainer with ONE goal: for he and his Rocket Friend Snout to BE THE BEST! He has been trying for 27 years!

title: 742 Evergreen
overview: Two on call police officers respond to a call, where they suspect everything is not what it seems
